title: Measuring narrative form across a century reveals persistent medium signatures amid convergence: replication package
description: Code and released data to reproduce every number, table, and figure in the paper with a single command (run_all.sh). Includes the validated language-model instrument, the aggregate human benchmark from 711 readers and 225 viewers, the scored narrative atlas of 149,341 films, novels, and television works (1890-2025), and the codebook.
